# Copilot entry point

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the canonical repository rules,
including operating mode, live safety, documentation, validation, API/feature
contract synchronization, and dependency licensing. Do not duplicate that
contract here.

Database tasks require `database-management` and only the relevant focused
advisors. PostgreSQL and artifact-only analytics use their existing specialists.

Autonomous plan execution remains explicitly invoked with its existing approval
contract. A research recommendation does not authorize production mutation,
deployment, or a bypass of live-scrape parity.
